Question: In circle \(O,\) \(G\) is a moving point on diameter \(\overline{AB}.\) \(\overline{AA'}\) is drawn perpendicular to \(\overline{AB}\) and equal to \(AG.\) \(\overline{BB'}\) is drawn perpendicular to \(\overline{AB},\) on the same side of diameter \(\overline{AB}\) as \(\overline{AA'},\) and equal to \(BG.\) Let \(O'\) be the midpoint of \(\overline{A'B'}.\) Then, as \(G\) moves from \(A\) to \(B,\) point \(O':\)

Choices.A: moves on a straight line parallel to \(AB\)
Choices.C: moves on a straight line perpendicular to \(AB\)
Choices.D: moves in a small circle intersecting the given circle
Choices.E:
follows a path which is neither a circle nor a straight
line
